scope.countries: Japan, manufacturing plants (plant-level data on manufacturers)
scope.period: 1981-2000 (the 1990s versus the 1980s); the zombie counterfactual compares steady states in 1989 and 1999
scope.population_or_sector: Japan, manufacturing plants (plant-level data on manufacturers)

entries.locator: Introduction, p.2：「The average reallocation term was -0.18% during the 1980s and it was -0.85% during the 1990s.」

japan_application.method: 他国・他産業の値は、日本へそのまま当てず、比較の外側の目安か検算の下限・上限として使う。
japan_application.caveat: These numbers come from the 2009 RIETI working paper, not the published RED version. The 37% figure rests on a calibrated model whose zombie definition (below the 20th TFP percentile for 5 years) and tax-wedge identification are assumptions rather than credit data. The sample is manufacturing only, so the result cannot be extended to services.
